fields.description: Issue includes editorials and columns on Miami civic affairs and local controversies, including criticism of utility meter deposits and the city’s use of meter testers; discussion of the Miami River as an unsightly and obstructed feature needing cleanup and improved bridge design; commentary on tourism promotion and “fly-by-night” travel agencies; notes on restaurant permit applications and licensing; public health statistics countering epidemic rumors; traffic-law enforcement and tail-light arrests; Miami Beach council politics and selection of a successor to councilman Bill Scott; University of Miami campus notes and sports coverage; boxing promotions and entertainment listings (films and stage productions such as “What Price Glory” and “The Dover Road”).
